Nephritic syndrome is a disorder of the glomerular (clusters of microscopic blood vessels in the kidneys with small pores through which blood is filtered). It is characterized by body tissue swelling (oedema), high blood pressure, proteinuria, azotemia, decreased urine output and the presence of red blood cells in the urine.

Neurological disorder is any disorder of the nervous system that includes structural, biochemical or electrical abnormalities in the brain, spinal cord or other nerves.
